name: Trulieve Cannabis Corp.
summary: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. operates as a cannabis retailer in the United States. The company cultivates, processes, and manufactures cannabis products and distributes its products to its dispensaries, as well as through home delivery. It sells flowers, edibles, vapes, oral, topical, concentrates, and accessories under the Avenue, Cultivar Collection, Muse, Modern Flower, Alchemy, Momenta, Sweet Talk, Co2lors, and Roll One brands. The company operates dispensaries in Florida, Arizona, Georgia, Ohio, Maryland, West Virginia, Connecticut, and Pennsylvania.
